versions.content: Definition of CommunicationCluster Communication- Cluster represents a formal way to express that a number of EcuInstance s are linked by an arbitrary topology (bus, star, ring, tree). Depending on the communication standard, a CommunicationCluster may either have exactly one or more (redun- dant) PhysicalChannel s.
